title: I love this app but It needs some changes.
body:
First of all, thank to whoever created this app. I was looking for a routine planner and when I found this, I was shook. So I just wanna say Thank you ❤️

The only thing the developer should change is to have the ability to add more habits without the need of subscribing. It isn’t important to do so. Please, I’m looking forward to this and It’s great but this minor change can do a lot. Thank you 🪴
